title: Iodine Supply in Switzerland: Current Status and Recommendations
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The federal expert report describes Hans Eggenberger’s 1922 campaign in Appenzell Ausserrhoden, a petition with 3,480 signatures, cantonal approval and iodized salt distribution. It also describes earlier work by Otto Bayard and a later national recommendation; signatures are not consumers or coverage.
